bio: I am a paediatric surgeon and paediatric urologist based in India, trained through a residency in General Surgery, an M.Ch. in Paediatric Surgery at Madras Medical College (where I was awarded the University Gold Medal as the best outgoing student), and a Fellowship in Paediatric Urology at Sri Ramachandra Institute of Higher Education & Research, Chennai.

My practice focuses on paediatric urology and reconstructive surgery, neonatal surgery, laparoscopic GI, hepatobiliary and thoracic surgery, paediatric tumours, and paediatric trauma and surgical emergencies.
